No. A 2.1:1 contrast ratio fails WCAG AA.

- **Required for normal text:** 4.5:1 (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3, Contrast Minimum)
- **Required for large text** (18pt / 24px, or 14pt bold / 18.66px bold): 3:1

A button label at normal font size therefore needs at least 4.5:1, so the grey-on-white combination would need the text darkened (or the background changed) to pass. At 2.1:1 it would also fall short of the large-text threshold and of Level AAA (7:1 for normal text).
